about.name: Abhinav Rai
about.about: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 9 years of experience specializing in high-performance frontend systems (70%) paired with resilient backend service delivery (30%). Deep expertise designing scalable React and Next.js architectures, micro-frontends, and architecting Node.js BFF (Backend-for-Frontend) layers backed by Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and MySQL. Proven track record owning global checkout, pricing platforms, and multi-gateway payment integrations. Advanced practitioner of agentic AI-assisted engineering workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) to radically accelerate delivery lifecycles, automate test coverage, and elevate code hygiene. Open to international relocation and remote contracts.

description: Led frontend and BFF development for Pricing V5, migrating to a single-vertical, add-on-based pricing model, launching a new Pro plan and enterprise sales package within a tight 6-month delivery timeline.
Extended and adapted Go and MongoDB pricing endpoints to aggregate custom checkout payloads, cutting dependency on core backend teams and speeding up feature delivery cycles.

Unified cross-vertical checkout architecture (Pricing V4), integrating CRM, Conversation, and Phone offerings into a streamlined checkout flow with multi-gateway payments (Stripe, Adyen) and localized compliance handling.
Designed and governed micro-frontend architecture using Webpack Module Federation, establishing shared navigation patterns and unblocking independent deployments for 6+ distributed squads.

Drove comprehensive web performance initiatives, elevating Lighthouse scores from 50 to 90+, cutting bundle sizes by 60%, and slashing First Contentful Paint (FCP) by 40% via code-splitting and edge caching.

Integrated agentic AI engineering workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) across a team of 6 engineers to automate API contract mockups, accelerate Jest regression test generation, and enforce SonarCloud quality baselines.
Guaranteed production stability during Brevo rebranding, coordinating complex frontend theme migrations and comprehensive QA validation workflows across the new global domain.
Developed end-to-end V2 pricing and checkout user journeys, standardizing state management flows, component-level caching, and smooth frontend API integrations.
Decoupled pricing infrastructure from legacy monolith, migrating systems into a dedicated, high-ownership React repository with standardized Webpack compilation pipelines.
Architected reusable shared UI component libraries, publishing them as internal packages to eliminate cross-team dependencies and accelerate release cycles by 30%.
Integrated global payment methods, embedding PayPal and Direct Debit payment streams into existing pricing and checkout flows with full client-side validation.
Built and supported utility Node.js/Express APIs, backing internal services with MongoDB data structures to support frontend release workflows and pricing mocks.
Optimized legacy React components, refactoring lifecycle methods and reducing re-renders to significantly improve application responsiveness and maintainability.
Maintained 80%+ unit test coverage across all mission-critical billing flows using Jest and React Testing Library to prevent checkout regressions.
Spearheaded full migration of the flagship startup platform to React, slashing homepage initial load times from 9s to 0.8s while delivering end-to-end Personal and Business Loan eligibility flows.

Engineered custom high-throughput sitemap scraper in Node.js, extracting, indexing, and cataloging over 250,000+ dynamic URLs to shatter the 500-URL limitation of free commercial tools and massively boost technical SEO search rankings.
Developed internal Node.js and Express REST APIs utilizing MySQL relational storage for structured loan applications alongside MongoDB for dynamic customer tracking.
Architected an in-house CMS with custom rich-text editing capabilities, allowing non-technical marketing teams to publish dynamic landing pages and blogs autonomously.
Built an internal enterprise CRM dashboard utilizing Chart.js, Redux-Persist, and MongoDB, saving the startup significant recurring software licensing overhead.
Implemented dynamic JSON-LD SEO structured data and automated Node.js content scraping scripts to drive web visibility.

projects.title: StreamHub Report Builder
projects.description: High-performance analytics report builder built with React 18, TypeScript, Zustand, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, and Highcharts. Features client-side group reduction with a Simpson's-Paradox-safe ratio-metric aggregation engine (bounce rate), dynamic dual Y-axis visualization, context-aware multi-filter AND logic, debounced bidirectional URL state synchronization, and sortable tabular dataset inspection.

projects.title: ToDo MERN (Full-Stack Notes App)
projects.description: Modern full-stack notes management application built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and DaisyUI on the frontend, powered by an Express 5 and Mongoose 9 REST API. Features distributed sliding-window IP rate limiting (30 req / 60s) via Upstash Redis, MongoDB Atlas persistence, and unified deployment architecture for single-service hosting.
